description: GoDaddy Inc. is a global leader serving a large market of entrepreneurs, developing and delivering easy-to-use solutions as a one-stop shop provider, backed by proactive, informed and personalized guidance, and serving small businesses, individuals, organizations, developers, designers and domain investors. Its vision is to radically shift the global economy toward life-fulfilling entrepreneurial ventures and its mission is to empower entrepreneurs everywhere, making opportunity more inclusive for all, and it has 20.4 million customers. It manages and reports its business in two segments, Applications and Commerce, and International Domains.
